translations.1: And it was on the eighth day — Moses called to Aaron and his sons, and to the elders of the sons of Israel.
translations.2: And he said to Aaron: 'Take a calf from the cattle for the purification-offering, and a ram for the ascent-offering — both without blemish — and bring them near before God.'
translations.3: And command the sons of Israel, saying: Take a he-goat from the goats for the purification-offering, and a calf and a lamb, sons of a year, without blemish, for the ascent-offering;
translations.4: and a bull and a ram for the well-being offering, to be slaughtered before God; and a gift-offering mixed with oil — for today God shall reveal Himself to you.'
translations.5: And they brought forward what Moses had commanded, to the entrance of the tent of the assembly; and all the congregation drew near, and stood before God.
translations.6: And Moses said: 'This is the matter which God has commanded you — do it, and the munificence of God shall reveal itself to you.'
translations.7: And he said to Aaron: 'Draw near to the altar and perform your purification-offering and your ascent-offering, and seek forgiveness for yourself and for the people; then perform their offering and seek forgiveness for them — as God has commanded.'
translations.8: And Aaron drew near to the altar, and slaughtered the calf of the purification-offering which was his.
translations.9: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in it, and placed it upon the corners of the altar; and the remainder of the blood he poured out at its base.
translations.11: And its flesh and its hide he burned with fire, outside the encampment.
translations.12: Then he slaughtered the ascent-offering; and the sons of Aaron conveyed the blood to him, and he sprinkled it upon the altar all around.
translations.13: And they conveyed to him the limbs of the ascent-offering together with the head; and he burned them in fire upon the altar.
translations.14: And he washed the entrails and the legs, and burned them in fire upon the altar.
translations.15: Then he brought forward the offering of the people, and took the he-goat of the purification-offering which was theirs, and slaughtered it, and performed the purification with it as with the first.
translations.16: Then he brought forward the ascent-offering, and performed it according to the established practice.
translations.17: Then he brought forward the gift-offering, and filled his palm from it, and burned it in fire upon the altar — in addition to the morning ascent-offering.
translations.18: And he slaughtered the bull and the ram — the well-being sacrifice belonging to the people; and the sons of Aaron conveyed the blood to him, and he sprinkled it upon the altar all around.
translations.19: And the fats from the bull and from the ram — the broad tail, and what covers the entrails, and the two kidneys, and the lobe of the liver —
translations.20: they placed the fat together with the breasts; and he burned the fats in fire upon the altar.
translations.21: And the breasts and the right thigh — Aaron waved them in a waving before God, as Moses had commanded.
translations.22: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them; and he descended from performing the purification-offering, and the ascent-offering, and the well-being sacrifice.
translations.23: And Moses and Aaron entered into the tent of the assembly, and they came out and blessed the people; and the munificence of God revealed itself to them.
translations.24: For a fire came forth from the presence of God, and consumed upon the altar the ascent-offering and the fats; and when the people saw this, they cried out, and fell upon their faces.
